question: A mobile phone was purchased for Rs 15,500. Its value depreciates at the rate of 20% per year. Find its value after two years.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net depreciation percentage for 2 years at 20% p.a. = −20 − 20 + (20 × 20) / 100 = −36%

The value after 2 years will be (100 − 36)% = 64% of the original value.

Value after 2 years = 64% of 15500

Value after 2 years = (64 / 100) × 15500 = 64 × 155 = 9920

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 9920.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Initial value of the mobile phone (P) = Rs. 15,500

Rate of depreciation (R) = 20% per year

Time period (n) = 2 years
